title: Beta Brings Electric Airplane to Farnborough Flying Display
summary: Beta Technologies has brought two examples of its electric aircraft to this year’s Farnborough International Airshow: the piloted Alia CX300 electric airplane, which is taking part in the flying display, and the uncrewed, hybrid-electric Alia MV250 defense variant, which is parked in the static display.
